tabs.label: Wall time per run
tabs.sql: SELECT run_id, "0_wall_time_seconds" AS wall_time_s, CASE WHEN experiment LIKE '%noise' THEN 'noise' ELSE 'baseline' END AS state, tag, CASE WHEN instr(experiment, '_') > 0 THEN substr(experiment, 1, instr(experiment, '_') - 1) ELSE '' END AS rep FROM app_0 ORDER BY tag, state, rep, run_id
tabs.chartTitle: Quantum ESPRESSO: wall time per run

tabs.label: Average wall time
tabs.sql: SELECT tag, CASE WHEN experiment LIKE '%noise' THEN 'noise' ELSE 'baseline' END AS state, AVG("0_wall_time_seconds") AS avg_wall_time_s FROM app_0 GROUP BY tag, state ORDER BY tag, state
